instruction: I want to change how Thunderbird handles reply positioning. Could you help me configure Thunderbird to place my replies below the quoted text instead of above it?

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing reply positioning from above quoted text (reply_on_top=1) to below quoted text (reply_on_top=0). Verified in cache: current value is 1, task requires changing to 0.
metadata.verified: Checked cache prefs.js - mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top is currently 1, task requires changing it to 0

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly fetches Thunderbird preferences file (prefs.js) where reply positioning setting is stored
Metric function check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js using regex and JSON, then verifies mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top == 0
Expected value is semantically correct: reply_on_top=0 means replies below quoted text (per metadata verification)
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are flushed to disk before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact setting required by instruction (reply positioning)
Edge cases handled: returns 0.0 if file is None, handles missing keys via expect_metrics dict, skips unparseable lines
Logic flow is sound: user changes setting → Thunderbird saves → postconfig closes app → getter fetches file → metric verifies → clear pass/fail

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
